docs.t: Azure Migration & Modernisation
x: Move with the foundation to grow
A successful migration makes the estate easier to govern, secure and operate. Quadra starts with dependencies and the target operating model, then selects the right Azure treatment for each workload.
Assess before moving

Inventory infrastructure, applications, databases, licensing, performance, security and recovery needs. Group workloads into migration waves by dependency and business risk; agree validation, cutover and rollback criteria before execution.
Establish the landing zone

Design or remediate management groups, subscriptions, identity, network connectivity, policy, logging, backup and recovery. Cloud Adoption Framework principles shape guardrails and operational readiness rather than treating the landing zone as an isolated deployment.
Modernise the estate
Move Windows, Linux, SAP and VMware workloads from on-premises, AWS or Google Cloud to Azure.
Modernise the estate
Assess SQL Server compatibility and select Azure SQL Database, Managed Instance or SQL on Azure VMs; consider PostgreSQL, MySQL and Cosmos DB where appropriate.
Modernise the estate
Support Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Files and Azure NetApp Files, with Azure Arc for hybrid management.
Modernise the estate
Design connectivity and application access using ExpressRoute, Virtual WAN, Front Door, Application Gateway and WAF.
Validate, optimise and hand over

Protect data integrity through validation and planned recovery steps. Tune availability, performance and cost after cutover, and transition monitoring, backup, disaster recovery and operating runbooks into the agreed support model. Well-Architected and FinOps reviews identify the next improvements. Downtime windows and migration methods depend on workload constraints and the agreed sequence.

docs.t: Azure Application Innovation

Connect legacy systems, simplify software delivery and build useful digital experiences on Azure. Quadra brings application and database engineering together with integration, DevOps and operations.
Choose change deliberately

Assess the portfolio before selecting rehost, replatform, refactor, rearchitect, rebuild or replace. Modernisation should address a business constraint, not introduce microservices or AI where a simpler approach will do.
Applications and integration
Use App Service, AKS, Container Apps and Functions for web, API and event-driven workloads. Connect ERP and SAP through API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus and Event Grid.
Engineering automation
GitHub Enterprise, Copilot, Actions and Azure DevOps support CI/CD, testing, infrastructure as code, release governance and DevSecOps.
Intelligent experiences
Develop knowledge assistants, document processing, search and workflow applications using approved business context, integration controls and appropriate human review.
Keep application and database decisions together

SQL and database modernisation, cloud-to-cloud transitions, VMware and Azure Arc-enabled hybrid options are assessed alongside application dependencies. Monitoring, observability, hardening, reliability and performance are part of the operating design.
Make the first application a repeatable pattern

Typical starting points include connected manufacturing workflows, life-sciences knowledge applications, retail and partner portals, employee services and API ecosystems. Agree delivery and performance measures, learn from the first release, then extend the pattern across the portfolio. Managed support and FinOps can sustain improvement after launch.

docs.t: Azure Data, Analytics & AI
x: Unify data. Improve decisions. Put intelligence to work.

Build a governed foundation for analytics and AI with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, SQL and Microsoft Foundry. Quadra connects data engineering, business context and production operation around a defined problem.
Modernise and connect the data estate

Assess databases, warehouses, lakes and legacy reporting. Plan migration from Synapse, Data Factory and other platforms where justified; Fabric and Databricks can complement one another rather than requiring a blanket replacement.
Build the right platform
Fabric: OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, engineering, semantic models, Power BI, data science and Real-Time Intelligence.
Build the right platform
Databricks: scalable ingestion, medallion architecture, transformation, machine learning and platform optimisation.
Build the right platform
Analytics and IoT: operational dashboards, streaming data, plant and asset monitoring, predictive insight and event-driven decisions.
Build the right platform
AI: retrieval-augmented generation, search, document intelligence and business-process assistants grounded in approved enterprise data.
Engineer trust and day-two operation

Purview, catalogue and lineage, access controls and data quality support governance. DataOps and MLOps introduce deployment, testing and environment controls; evaluation, monitoring and security support AI use. Managed services cover platform health, capacity, performance, FinOps and continuous enhancement.
Start with Azure AI Launchpad

A focused discovery engagement reviews business pain points, application and data landscapes, analytics maturity and priority use cases. Outputs include readiness observations, architecture options, a proof-of-value recommendation and a phased roadmap. Scope and engagement format are agreed before starting.
Connect to the decisions that matter

Explore production and quality visibility, BFSI risk and reporting, pharma operations, retail inventory, IT service analytics or finance and procurement intelligence. Choose success measures with the business owner before building.
Integrate without assuming identical controls

Where Fabric and Azure Databricks interoperate, validate the specific mirroring or shortcut pattern, read behaviour and access model. Governance policies must be checked across the participating systems; they should not be assumed to transfer automatically.

docs.t: Azure Security, Governance & FinOps
x: Build trust into every layer of Azure

Security works best as part of the cloud operating model. Quadra brings identity, workload protection, network controls, data governance and cost accountability into Azure architecture and ongoing operations.
Control access and exposure

Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access and managed identities support least privilege. Defender for Cloud supports posture and workload reviews; Firewall, WAF, private endpoints, Front Door and Application Gateway strengthen network and application boundaries.
Connect detection to an operating model

Sentinel analytics, incident handling and response automation connect cloud telemetry to investigation. Explore our Microsoft Security practice for the broader identity, data and security-operations programme, connected to the Azure implementation.
Govern the estate
Landing-zone controls: management groups, subscriptions, RBAC, Azure Policy, tagging, naming, logging and workload isolation.
Govern the estate
Data controls: Purview classification, sensitivity, lineage, lifecycle and evidence visibility.
Govern the estate
AI controls: model and tool access, network isolation, grounding, evaluation, tracing and content safety.
Govern the estate
FinOps: budgets, allocation, right-sizing, capacity, reservation utilisation and commitment governance.
Prioritise the next improvement

Choose a landing-zone review, identity and privileged-access assessment, Sentinel readiness review, Purview assessment, FinOps review or AI security readiness engagement. Well-Architected and security-baseline reviews connect findings to an actionable roadmap. Agree controls, evidence requirements and remediation owners, then carry the resulting policies and response responsibilities into managed operations.
